quote: We live close together and we live far apart. We all go through the same things—it’s all just a different kind of the same thing.
source: Susan Glaspell, Trifles, the one act, near the close (Mrs. Hale) (Plays, Small, Maynard and Company, 1920)
speaker: Mrs. Hale

evidence.where: the transcribed 1920 Small, Maynard volume Plays, read at the passage and at the title page and contents
evidence.edition: Susan Glaspell, Plays (Boston: Small, Maynard and Company, 1920), copyright page and contents confirmed; Trifles is the first play in the volume
evidence.locator: Trifles, the one act, in Mrs. Hale’s speech beginning I might have known she needed help, shortly before the curtain

reason: The 1920 text reads exactly this and ends the sentence in a full stop before the stage direction, so no cut is being disguised. The other transcription in circulation, Project Gutenberg 10623, is a modern gathering that also holds The Verge and Inheritors and so is not the 1920 volume; the citation names the 1920 one, which was checked.
